description: Base RPC endpoint, pay per call: any allowlisted read-only JSON-RPC method on Base mainnet (eth_call, eth_getBalance, eth_getLogs, eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_getTransactionReceipt and more) with your own params, no API key. Revert reasons come back as the result. Input: method; optional params. $0.05 per call. Returns: method, result or error, endpoint.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_chain_rpc
title: Base RPC passthrough
